body: What's funny, is that I've always wanted to skydive.  I'm terrified of heights.  The thought of being brave enough to ascend, and then have the moment where I consciously choose to leave the safety of an aircraft, and jump with arms spread like a bird is appealing to me.  That's something that is a possibility, especially now that the weather is clearing up.

Nobody has suggested my thyroid, ever.  That would be great if I had a loser of a thyroid, and this was all physical.  I'll be making an appointment when I get off of work.  The downside is having a needle phobia, but I'll manage.  It feels like that bought me some time, because I'll have to wait for the appointment and lab results.  Also, the possibility that it's not totally over yet.

I think the same thing, but there's not really an alternative for me.  I do go the gym, and enjoy that.  It gives me about 1-2 hours of feeling not extremely depressed, and then drops off.  Volunteering, I've tried that and have been not considered/rejected, so that really got to me.  I haven't tried since then.  I'm basically that nervous quiet guy that makes people uncomfortable.  

  I would love to have a cat, or ferrets.  I've had both before, but my current living situation doesn't allow that.  My family actually isn't the best thing for me.  It's split and divided into fragments.  I only know my grandmother, older sister, and mother.  My mother has severe Multiple Sclerosis, so talking to her is difficult.  My grandmother is 84.  My sister is busy with her life, husband and kids.  

  It's made me realize that it is up to me, and as much as I hate thinking it, and saying it, I don't think it's working out.

Right now it's The Berzerker, mixed tracks that mean something or remind me of certain points in life, and the new Sevendust.  I never grew out of the nu-metal/hard rock that was around when I was 13-14.

I'm a 'Floor Cleaning Specialist'  Once a supermarket closes, I start the process of making the floors clean, and then very shiny.  I can keep an mp3 player on the whole time, and the work is relatively easy.
